title: The Water Cycle
note_type: Sample demonstration note for Study Buddy (fictional, not a real student's notes)
summary: The water cycle is the continuous movement of water between the oceans, the air and the land, powered by energy from the Sun.

stages.name: Evaporation
stages.description: The Sun heats water in oceans, lakes and rivers and it turns into water vapour.

stages.name: Transpiration
stages.description: Plants release water vapour from their leaves into the air.

stages.name: Condensation
stages.description: Water vapour cools as it rises and forms tiny droplets, which make clouds.

stages.name: Precipitation
stages.description: Droplets join together and fall as rain, snow, sleet or hail.

stages.name: Collection
stages.description: Water gathers in oceans, rivers, lakes and underground (groundwater), and the cycle repeats.
